course.title: Complex Variable, Vector Analysis and Statistics
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose there are 5500 candidates in any examination of a qualification test. Let the average score is 70 (in percentage) and variance is 36. Assume that scores are normally distributed. Find the expected number of candidates who are
i) not qualified (i.e., score is less than 60),
ii) qualified but not eligible for choosing any specific field (i.e., 60< score<75),
iii) eligible for choosing any department (i.e., score>80).
